claude.performance_metric: no in-window public financials; continued operating (3,000+ employees, 21 locations mid-2021), rebranded AMRI→Curia (Jul 2021), two biologics acquisitions integrated by Feb 2022
claude.rationale: The realized-record slice documents continued operation at comparable-or-larger scale (3,000+ employees in 21 locations as of mid-2021 vs ~3,100 in March 2021), a corporate rebrand, and two biologics acquisitions integrated under the Curia brand by February 2022; no product/operations incoherence is documented, so p4_pathway = 0. No process/organization fracture (operations vs people/management/culture) is documented either — the entity was in fact named a Forbes best employer for 2021 — so p5_pathway = 0. Because the company deregistered at closing and filed no post-2017 periodic reports, the slice supports no primary-sourced financial-scalar or distress outcome, and provides no evidence bearing on controlling-intent archetype coherence (t1) or business-model reconcilability (t2), which are therefore uncertain.
